Platinum series · PL

Platinum

Released February 11, 2009 · 133 cards

Platinum is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Platinum series, released in English on February 11, 2009. Its main set has 127 cards, plus 6 secret rares numbered beyond the set (133 in total). It includes 115 Pokémon, 17 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

23 illustrators worked on Platinum. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (18), Kouki Saitou (17), Kagemaru Himeno (15), Ryo Ueda (10), Masakazu Fukuda (7), Makoto Imai (6), Atsuko Nishida (5), Ken Sugimori (5).
